page.overview:
What is Southern Island?

Southern Island is a location introduced in .

It is an island on the south of the Hoenn region. It is where either Latias or Latias can be found.

Mega Bracelet; yes; From Steven after defeating Team Magma/Team Aqua and obtaining Latios/Latias Soul Dew; yes; Obtained after defeating Latias/Latios, during the visit with Eon Ticket

In , the player is required to have the Eon Ticket to access the Southern Island. With the item, the player must go to the Lilycove City Harbor, whereupon the S.S Tidal's captain offers to take them to Southern Island. If the player accepts and then arrives at the island, they must go deeper into the island, where an unusual stone can be found. The stone object contains the inscription:
